Greenville Weekend Warrior Ride (White Clay Bicycle Club)

Greenville, DE · Road

Greenville Weekend Warrior Ride (White Clay Bicycle Club) is a road group ride in Greenville, DE. It rolls every Saturday at 9:00 am from Janssen's Market.

How we know

White Clay Bicycle Club's ride calendar lists the Greenville Weekend Warrior Ride on Saturdays Oct 3, 10, 17, 24 and 31, 2026, 9:00 am to 1:00 pm, from Janssen's Market, 3801 Kennett Pike (calendar fetched Oct 1, 2026).

For visitors

Pre-registration is required (SignUpGenius link on the calendar entry). Helmet required, lights strongly encouraged. Arrive 15 minutes early for the safety talk. Park away from the store entrance.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 9:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 13-14 mph: steady — you'll breathe hard on the hills. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at @whiteclaybicycleclub the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Greenville Weekend Warrior Ride (White Clay Bicycle Club) group ride

A club ride of about 42 miles at 13-14 mph average, with a cruising speed of 15-17 mph. There is no pacelining; keep one to two bike lengths between riders. The group regroups as needed and stops at the Northbrook Market Place.
